setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern, C3 D3 E3 F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, through the test MIDI device at 90 BPM with Rate /1 and channel range steps 1-4. The sequencer is stopped. Song mode is On, and the song has one slot with a 64-step global length. Every other option is at its default: Reset on song seq change is On and Reset on pattern repeat is Off.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Hold step 1 and tap step 3 to set the range to steps 1-3. On Channel tasks > Clock set Clock Mod to /9. One step now lasts nine sixteenths (1.5 seconds), so the three notes 60, 62, 64 cycle every 4.5 seconds, while the song pattern repeats every 64 steps (10.7 seconds). The two never line up, which is what makes the reset visible.
steps.title: Make a slow channel

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC. Make sure Song mode is On, then turn Reset on song seq change Off and Reset on pattern repeat Off. Close the menu, press Play and let it run for 24 seconds, then stop. The phrase carries on across each repeat: 60 62 64 60 62 64 60 62, then 64 at 12 seconds. Read the note times in the MIDI strip.
steps.title: Both resets off: the phase carries on

steps.caption: Turn Reset on song seq change On and play 24 seconds. A pattern that is only repeating is not restarted by a song change, so the phrase still carries on, with the same note times as before.
steps.title: Reset on song seq change alone

steps.caption: Turn Reset on song seq change Off and Reset on pattern repeat On, close the menu and play 24 seconds. At each 64-step boundary, 10.7 and 21.3 seconds, the slow channel restarts: note 60 sounds exactly at the boundary instead of waiting for the old cycle. Compare the note times in the MIDI strip with the first run.
steps.title: Reset at each repeat

steps.caption: Turn Reset on song seq change On as well, so both options are On, and play 24 seconds. The channel restarts at each repeat, as in the last step.
steps.title: Turn both reset options on

steps.caption: Select Song mode and turn E3 left to Off; both reset options stay On. Close the menu and play 24 seconds. With Song mode Off the slot is not stepped by the song, so neither reset applies: the phrase runs continuously again, with 64 at 12 seconds.
steps.title: Song mode off: no reset
